limitations: The final gold and explicit-local cases were run once; the corporate held-out required one documented full-chain recovery run after an empty structured map.
The content-world chain took 79.3 to 108.776 seconds in successful final-package runs and consumed 13262 to 17047 total tokens per run.
The explicit-local run preserved its business and local map paths but still selected the broader preferred root, so soft-prior strength is not yet calibrated across industries.
This evidence covers content-root and map behavior, not production, publication, or outcome learning.
